package.description: .NET obfuscator and licensing solution for protecting .NET applications

en-US.description: .NET obfuscator and licensing solution for protecting .NET applications
en-US.longDescription: ArmDot is a .NET obfuscator and software protection tool designed to protect .NET assemblies from reverse engineering. It provides multiple protection techniques including control flow obfuscation, string encryption, and code virtualization. ArmDot also includes a licensing API for implementing software activation and licensing systems.
en-US.name: ArmDot
